description: Get supported cryptocurrencies and networks on Flashift. Optionally filter by symbol, network, or search keyword.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50).

network.description: Filter by network (e.g. eth, bsc, trx, btc).

search.description: Search query matching symbol, fullname, or network.

symbol.description: Filter by currency symbol (e.g. btc, eth, usdt).

name: get_currencies
title: Get Currencies
